otherValues.0x58: This is a BMP280: no humidity sensor. Common mix-up with cheap boards.

gotchas.text: Many boards sold as BME280 carry a BMP280, which has no humidity sensor. The chip ID register 0xD0 tells them apart: 0x60 is a BME280, 0x58 a BMP280.
Read in normal mode at a high rate, the sensor warms itself and reads high. For weather readings use forced mode, about one reading per minute.

source.section: Recommended modes of operation: weather monitoring

current.note: At 1 reading per second of humidity, pressure and temperature; chip only (a breakout's regulator adds a little).

registers.note: The app writes the register address, then reads the bytes. The calibration data (0x88 to 0xA1 and 0xE1 to 0xE7) is different on every chip and is not decoded here.

registers.name: id
registers.text: Chip ID. Tells which chip is really on the board.

values.0x58: This is a BMP280: no humidity sensor. Common mix-up with cheap boards.

registers.name: reset
registers.text: Soft reset: writing 0xB6 restarts the chip. It always reads 0x00.

registers.name: ctrl_hum
registers.text: Humidity oversampling. A change takes effect only after the next write to ctrl_meas.

fields.name: osrs_h
fields.text: How many times humidity is sampled per reading.

values.0: Skipped: this value is not measured.

registers.name: status
registers.text: What the chip is doing right now.

fields.name: im_update
fields.text: Set while calibration data is copied from the chip's memory.

values.1: Copying calibration data (after power-on or a reset).

registers.name: ctrl_meas
registers.text: Temperature and pressure oversampling, and the power mode.

fields.name: osrs_t
fields.text: How many times temperature is sampled per reading.

values.0: Skipped: this value is not measured.

fields.name: osrs_p
fields.text: How many times pressure is sampled per reading.

values.0: Skipped: this value is not measured.
Sleep mode: no measurements. The result registers keep their last values.
values.1: Forced mode: one measurement, then back to sleep.
values.2: Forced mode: one measurement, then back to sleep.
values.3: Normal mode: measures again and again, with the standby time from config.

registers.name: config
registers.text: Standby time, filter and interface options. In normal mode the chip may ignore writes here: write it in sleep mode.

fields.name: t_sb
fields.text: Pause between two measurements in normal mode.

fields.name: filter
fields.text: IIR filter: smooths quick jumps in pressure and temperature, like a door slamming.

fields.name: spi3w_en
fields.text: 3-wire SPI mode. Has no effect over I2C.

registers.name: press
registers.text: Raw pressure reading (20 bits). It becomes hPa only with the chip's calibration data.

values.0x80000: No result: this value is skipped, or nothing was measured since power-on.

registers.name: temp
registers.text: Raw temperature reading (20 bits). It becomes °C only with the chip's calibration data.

values.0x80000: No result: this value is skipped, or nothing was measured since power-on.

registers.name: hum
registers.text: Raw humidity reading (16 bits). It becomes %RH only with the chip's calibration data.

values.0x8000: No result: this value is skipped, or nothing was measured since power-on.
